checks.A: >=2 distinct runnable candidate hashes in >=70% of eligible HIGH executions
checks.B: median elapsed minutes from S05 entry to first runnable event in HIGH <=70% of the corresponding LOW median
checks.C: every HIGH record matches the pre-registered AI provider/model/version/configuration hash and caps
checks.D: audited AI calls occur only while stage S05 is active

consequence.failure: BOTTLENECK_MIGRATION_INDETERMINATE; cannot become support or non-support
consequence.pass: allows other frozen evidence to be interpreted; does not itself support migration

eligible_denominator: all prospectively eligible assigned executions; never conditioned on acceptance or observed outcome
frozen_configuration_status: BLOCKED: configuration identity and enforcement not yet supplied
runnable_candidate_definition: A content-addressed candidate produced during S05 whose immutable source hash is recorded and for which the frozen build/start command exits zero and reaches the first frozen validation-gate entry event. Acceptance and later-gate passage are not required.
